title: Neighbor average
statement: For a regular multigraph $G$ of degree $D$, a function $f$ from its vertices to the rationals, and a vertex $v$, define the neighbor average at $v$ to be the sum of $f$ over the neighbors assigned to the $D$ edge slots at $v$, divided by $D$.
hypotheses_covered: A function from the vertices to the rationals
